input: /chrome-devrel I need to manage the launch of https://chromestatuslite.com/feature/5175745573945344 Connection Allowlists. I'm in DevRel
intent: A named prepare-to-ship launch-management request must execute public, reversible developer-enablement work rather than return only a plan, hypotheses, or gap analysis.
requiredBehaviors: retrieve current public feature, specification, implementation, test, standards-position, and documentation evidence
derive an ID-based feature-contract coverage manifest
create independently runnable feature-detection and minimal behavior samples
create focused failure, fallback, policy, and integration samples
create at least one realistic integrated use-case demo
run samples and demos against the real implementation rather than mocks
use chrome-devtools-mcp when available and exercise visible controls while inspecting console and network state
separate physical-device, remote-device, emulator, and viewport-only mobile evidence
report inventory_total = pass + fail + blocked and inventory_tested = pass + fail
separate observed friction, external-report reproduction outcomes, and hypotheses
report report_attempted = reproduced + not_reproduced and keep hypotheses outside execution denominators
audit live MDN, mdn/content, browser-compat-data, and Chrome-owned documentation
create repository-native patch-ready documentation additions or corrections when canonical sources and validation tooling are available
return concrete artifact and evidence paths plus residual blocked work
forbiddenBehaviors: stop after producing a plan, test runbook, demo plan, or documentation gap analysis when local execution is possible
present hypotheses or reported-but-unreproduced issues as observed friction
count mocked or simulated feature output as a real browser pass
report viewport emulation as physical or Android mobile-platform validation
claim MDN, formal-review, release, or editorial approval
open external issues or pull requests, publish, change production, or represent a team without a separate explicit action request and confirmed scope and authority
call generic prose patch-ready without a canonical repository, target path, pinned base revision, repository-native structure, and available build or preview checks
evidenceBoundary: Public research and reversible local drafts/tests are allowed by the launch-management request. Private evidence and external mutations require separate authorization and applicable access.

denominatorRules.hypotheses: outside all execution denominators until converted to test IDs
